name: Laquinta Ferreira-Osei's 'The Patience Table'
creator: Laquinta Ferreira-Osei
description: Occupying a converted water reclamation chamber on Tier 4's eastern residential belt since 2208, The Patience Table seats exactly eleven guests per evening and serves a single eighteen-course tasting menu priced at Φ2,400 per head, with a fourteen-month waiting list. Chef Laquinta Ferreira-Osei trained under three culinary traditions — Bahian moqueca technique, Cantonese slow-fire philosophy, and Yoruba ceremonial feast structuring — and each menu is built around a single real ingredient sourced from verified vertical farms, used across every course in different preparations. The restaurant has no neural feed presence; guests surrender their BCI signal at the door.
cultural_impact: The Patience Table redefined Meridian fine dining by centering absence — of augmentation, of neural distraction, of excess — at a moment when Spire dining culture was trending toward extreme sensory overload, and its influence pushed a wave of 'quiet cuisine' establishments across Tier 3 and 4.
controversy: A leaked internal review from a HelixCorp executive described the BCI surrender policy as 'aggressively anti-corporate theater,' and there are persistent rumors that HelixCorp has attempted to plant surveillance hardware in the chamber's walls on multiple occasions.
story_hooks: A guest on tonight's eleven-seat list is carrying information that two corponations would kill to suppress — and the BCI-silent room means no one can call for help.
Laquinta has been offered an obscene sum to move The Patience Table into the Spire; her refusal has made someone very powerful very angry.

The single real ingredient for this month's menu — a verified heritage tomato from a Tier 3 vertical farm — has been substituted with a near-perfect synthetic replica that only a trained palate could detect, and Laquinta's reputation is on the line.
